head: pan, .480 OD, captive flat washer (.50 OD; .75 OD on door-pull use)
notes: Screw with captive flat washer. NCRS NCC Vettecetera Nov 2021 article (Gary Beaupre) on a '66: 1/4-20 x 1/2 Phillips pan head with captured flat washer; glove box / window run versions black phosphate with .50 OD washer (head OD .480), door-pull versions zinc with .75 OD washer. 1970 AIM use (window guide cam) finish not confirmed. Zip and others sell it as 63-67 glove box hinge/support screws without size. Searches: 'GM 9418970', '9418970 AMK'.
